probes.check: am_probe_imgui_abi(): ImGui::DebugCheckVersionAndDataLayout with the glue's IMGUI_VERSION and sizes of ImGuiIO, ImGuiStyle, ImVec2, ImVec4, ImDrawVert and ImDrawIdx. The failure is recorded first, since ImGui asserts on a mismatch.

seeded_violation.description: Define ImDrawIdx as unsigned int for the glue in Dear ImGui's build fragment, while the imgui port is built with 16-bit indices.

adaptation_notes: The build fragment calls find_package(imgui CONFIG REQUIRED) and links imgui::imgui, which includes the SDL3 and SDL_GPU backends the port's sdl3-binding and sdlgpu3-binding features build.
Every translation unit that includes imgui.h must see the same ImDrawIdx, ImWchar (IMGUI_USE_WCHAR32) and IMGUI_USER_CONFIG as the library.
In probe builds the setup sets io.IniFilename = nullptr so probe runs write and read no imgui.ini.
